unbound: Deliberately not linked from its listing. The model is 165.0 x 99.4 x 88.0 cm; the real EKTORP is 179 x 88 x 88 cm. Matching it needs 22.6% non-uniform scale, and at the 10% cap (scripts/fit_glb.py exits 1) it is still 6.5 cm off in both width and depth. The cap is the line between 'this model is the product, slightly imprecise' and 'this is a different object stretched into the product's shape'. A 165 cm sofa labelled EKTORP is the second, in a product whose whole claim is that what you see is true to scale. The listing places as a true-size stand-in instead. To rebind: a model whose own proportions are within 10% of 179 x 88 x 88.
